name: Load entry from email into the TMS
overview: Dispatchers retype load and rate confirmation details from email into the TMS every morning.
spotlight: Runs off the inbox, writes straight into the TMS, flags anything ambiguous instead of guessing.

name: Carrier packet onboarding
overview: New carrier packets arrive as PDFs and get keyed into three systems by hand.
spotlight: Reads the packet, checks authority and insurance, files it, and opens an exception only when something does not check out.
